text:
jen-finance: Heads-up — Spendlyze renewal in ~30 days. Current contract = 12mo commit 200k tokens/month, we consumed ~75% average last year. Sales sent a 15% renewal discount and no change to commit. Should we push for usage-based or renegotiate commit structure? cc @sam-procure @alex_sales

sam-procure: Can you share last 6 months usage by product? Need to see variance before we decide.

jen-finance: Uploaded quick export: spendlyze_usage_q1-q4.csv (drive link) — main spikes from product evals and a couple infra benchmark months.

nate-ops: Note — embeddings are billed separately. IIRC Spendlyze has embeddings SKU measured per 1k vectors. Need to confirm if those are in the commit or billed outside.

alex_sales: I can ask our rep to split the commit (prod vs infra) and waive overage fees for 3 months while we ramp. They typically trade discount for higher commit. What discount should we target?

jen-finance: Targeting net 30-40% off list if possible. Also want a flexible tier for seasonal bursts (ramp up to 2x for 2 months). If we can get that baked into the contract, great.

liu-legal: Heads-up on contract terms — if we increase commit, legal will need to review DPA/CLA changes. Watch out for auto-renew or assignment clauses. Ping me if sales adds auto-renew with short opt-out.

sam-procure: Proposed negotiation framework: 2-tier commit: base 120k tokens/mo + burst pool 100k tokens/mo (billed only if used). Pricing: 40% off base, 20% off burst consumption. Embeddings remain metered at current rates. Also ask for 3 months overage waiver. Thoughts?

marie-cs: :thumbsup: That aligns with our forecast model and keeps cost predictable for product experiments. Also ask for one quarter of trial credits for upcoming evals.

procurement-bot: New vendor negotiation created: V-2026-78 (Spendlyze) — owner: sam-procure, target review date: 2026-04-15.

jen-finance: I'll draft the ask doc and spec the product vs infra mapping for the rep. @alex_sales can you request rep availability this week and flag any legal changes they require? Also need SOW-level mapping of commit to SKUs.

alex_sales: On it. Will loop in our account rep (alice@spendlyze.com) and request a split-commit proposal + sample SLA.

sam-procure: If the rep won't move on flexibility, fallback is evaluating MeterBridge as a replacement — migration estimate ~2-3 engineer-weeks and likely ~20% higher list price but more granular metering. I'll prepare a quick TCO if needed.

jen-finance: Let's prioritize negotiation with Spendlyze for now. Thanks all — I'll share the draft by EOD tomorrow. :pray:
